meta.name: cloud-architect
meta.description: Designs cloud architectures, creates migration plans, generates cost optimization recommendations, and produces disaster recovery strategies across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Use when designing cloud architectures, planning migrations, or optimizing multi-cloud deployments. Invoke for Well-Architected Framework, cost optimization, disaster recovery, landing zones, security architecture, serverless design.

copy.tagline: 设计云架构、规划迁移并优化成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计或优化多云架构
copy.tagline_en: Design cloud architectures, plan migrations, and optimize costs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design or optimize multi-cloud architectures

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你设计云架构、制定迁移计划、优化成本，并生成灾难恢复策略。它支持 AWS、Azure 和 GCP 三大云平台。
howto.when: 当你需要设计云架构、规划迁移或优化多云部署时触发。也适用于 Well-Architected 框架、成本优化、灾难恢复等场景。

say.text: 帮我设计一个高可用的 AWS 架构，包含 VPC 和自动伸缩组。
say.note: Claude 会生成架构图、服务选择、安全方案和成本估算。

say.text: 制定从本地迁移到 Azure 的 6R 迁移计划。
say.note: Claude 会输出迁移阶段、验证步骤和回滚方案。

say.text: 分析过去30天的 AWS 成本，找出主要开销来源。
say.note: Claude 会运行成本分析命令并给出优化建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you design cloud architectures, create migration plans, generate cost optimization recommendations, and produce disaster recovery strategies across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to design cloud architectures, plan migrations, or optimize multi-cloud deployments. Also applicable for Well-Architected Framework, cost optimization, disaster recovery, etc.

say_en.text: Design a highly available AWS architecture with VPC and auto-scaling group.
Create a 6R migration plan from on-premises to Azure.
say_en.note: Claude will output migration phases, validation steps, and rollback plan.

say_en.text: Analyze AWS costs for the last 30 days and identify top cost drivers.
say_en.note: Claude will run cost analysis commands and provide optimization suggestions.
